title: Серия года
subject: A magnificent freestanding hourglass with clear glass bulbs and warm amber sand flowing through its narrow waist. Elegant polished pale wood frame with restrained brass fittings. Around the foot, four tiny seasonal botanical details clearly express a full year: a small spring flower, a fresh summer leaf, an orange autumn maple leaf, and a crystalline winter snowflake. Hero silhouette is a complete upright hourglass. No clock dial, sun disk, book, calendar page, numbered badge or background scene.
palette: Transparent clear glass, amber-gold sand, honey wood, small pink/green/orange/icy-blue seasonal accents. Warm amber is dominant; no all-teal-and-copper colour scheme.

title: Создатель системы
subject: An exquisite freestanding clockwork construction / working system: several interlocking exposed toothed gears, an upright architectural silver frame, a luminous sapphire-blue central crystal, and precisely fitted mechanical components, on a compact pale marble plinth. Engrave a small clear 100 on the front ivory plaque. Make the mechanism visually harmonious and impressive, not random piled gears. Hero silhouette is an intricate open mechanical tower. No clock face, hands, trophy cup, mountain, flag, staircase, star, phone, robot or people.
palette: Cobalt and sapphire blue, bright brushed silver, pale ivory marble, tiny steel details. Cool blue and silver dominate, with only very small warm highlights. No jade-green or copper grading.

title: Тысяча выполнений
subject: One beautiful substantial golden trophy cup with two elegantly swept handles, a deep ruby-red jewel inset in its front, and an ivory stone pedestal engraved with a clearly legible 1000. Subtle sculpted laurel leaves adorn the sides of the pedestal, not a big wreath behind the cup. Hero silhouette is an unmistakable classic championship trophy. No stars, flags, medals, gears, hourglass, books or people.
palette: Rich polished yellow gold and warm cream, deep ruby red gemstone and a small burgundy ribbon detail. Gold and ruby-red dominate. No green or teal.

title: Коллекционер
subject: One open richly crafted treasure chest, three-quarter view, with a visibly deep plum-purple velvet interior. Inside, a carefully arranged small collection of cut gemstones in distinct shapes: a bright blue diamond, red ruby, emerald and amethyst, plus one pearl. Fine decorative wood carving and refined silver clasps. Hero silhouette is a broad open treasure chest, lid angled back; complete chest and lid fully visible. No star, trophy, paper, coins, wallet, smartphone or people.
palette: Dark walnut wood, royal-purple velvet, bright silver fittings and naturally multicoloured vivid jewels. Purple and walnut brown dominate. No uniform jade-and-copper palette.
